§6Gold-198§f

§aRadioactive gold, the seed for flashgold and balefire.§f

§bGold-198§f (Au-198) is a radioactive gold isotope that emits §e500 RAD/s§f. It's naturally pyrophoric from its own heat, so you need tungsten reachers to handle it safely.

§6Production§f:
§b• RBMK irradiation§f, breed natural gold in an irradiation channel
§b• SILEX extraction§f, §e1%§f chance from fallout piles, also extractable from spent flashgold and australium fuel

§6Uses§f:
§b• Flashgold§f, combine with antimatter cell and ionized particles for the balefire chain
§b• Liquidator Medal§f, armor modifier that removes §e10 RAD/s§f
§b• Self-charging Battery§f, produces §e2.5 kHE/tick§f
§b• RTG Pellet§f, §e100 HE/tick§f baseline, §e200 HE/tick§f with decay enabled (§e194,400 tick§f lifespan, yields §e58.3M HE§f total)

§ePS:§f Gold-198 is mostly a stepping stone to flashgold. Stockpile it in billet form for RBMK breeding, or extract from fallout if you've got a processing setup.
